svg.title: Repair an opposite-phase overlap
svg.desc: At the nominal source start 15, a tone with period 10 is opposite in phase to the previous patch continuation at 20. Moving the candidate start to 20 aligns them. A complementary cosine crossfade dips to zero at its midpoint before alignment and preserves the tone after alignment.
svg.text: A small source shift can repair the join
Previous patch continues at sample 20 · illustrative tone period: 10 samples
The shared waveform keeps its level
Both plots use the same 20-sample overlap and fade. Only the incoming patch’s source start changes.
